svg.text: TCAM map: four terms, one patient

g.text: TRADITIONAL
indigenous systems:
herbs, TBAs,
bone-setters
COMPLEMEN-
TARY
ALONGSIDE orthodox:
massage, prayer
ALTERNA-
TIVE
INSTEAD of orthodox:
herbs-only HIV!
INTEGRA-
TIVE ★
BEST of both,
evidence-led!
4 TERMS (exam!): TRADITIONAL (indigenous systems — Ghanaian herbs, TBAs, spiritualists)
· COMPLEMENTARY (used WITH orthodox — prayer + drip!) · ALTERNATIVE (used INSTEAD —
concoction INSTEAD of ARVs — DANGER!) · INTEGRATIVE ★ (best of both, evidence-led — the
GOAL!). Nurse's job: move patients from alternative → integrative, never mock the journey.
WHO STRATEGY: safe + effective + quality + regulated + integrated traditional medicine —
research it, regulate it (M06!), respect knowledge, protect herbs/species. Ghana LEADS Africa:
Act 575 + TMPC + herbal pharmacopoeia + university degrees (KNUST!). Quote it with pride.
WHY NURSES MUST KNOW: 80% of Ghanaians use traditional medicine; most NEVER tell the
hospital (fear of scolding!); herbs INTERACT (bleeding! liver! cancelled drugs!); delays KILL
(stroke at prayer camp 3 days!); beliefs DRIVE adherence. Ignorant nurses harm pluralist
patients — knowledgeable ones negotiate healing.
PLURALISM (BEH!): patients use hospital + herbalist + pastor TOGETHER — normal, ancient,
rational (each covers gaps others leave!). Map it (Kleinman!), safety-check it, coordinate
it — never demand single loyalty ("us OR them" loses patients to "them").
ORTHODOX BLIND SPOTS TCAM FILLS: meaning ("why ME?") · chronicity (diabetes forever!)
· access (herbalist next door, hospital 40km!) · cost (herbs cheaper!) · humanity (time +
touch + prayer!). Fix OUR gaps too — access + kindness + meaning keep patients.
EXAM MOVE: "define + differentiate" = 4 terms + Ghana example EACH + nurse's integrative
role. "Why study TCAM?" = 80% + silence + interactions + delays + adherence.
LINKS: BEH pluralism/Kleinman · COM negotiation · NUT myths · PRO-I respect.
MANTRA: "traditional honoured, complementary welcomed, alternative negotiated, care integrated."
